superiorskyblock.island_disband.title: Disbands player's island
superiorskyblock.island_disband.descript: The `Island Disband Action` disbands a player's island. This could be used to make a system of "re-birthing," where a player can disband their island and start over with benefits.
superiorskyblock.island_set_biome.title: Set a player's island's biome
superiorskyblock.island_set_biome.descri: The `Island Set Biome` action is used to set a player's island's biome. This could be used to simulate the seasons of the year, or to change the biome of the island to match the theme of the island.
Set a player's island's border size
The `Island Set Border Size` action is used to set a player's island's border size. It could be used to reward the player for completing a quest, or upon reaching a certain level.
superiorskyblock.island_set_member_limit: Set a player's island's member limit
The `Island Set Member Limit Action` is an action that sets the member limit of an island. This could be used as a reward for a quest or as if they reach a certain level.

superiorskyblock.on_island_create.title: When a player creates an Island
superiorskyblock.on_island_create.descri: The `Island Create Event` is triggered when an island is created. This event could be used to give the player starting items when they create an island.
superiorskyblock.on_island_disband.title: When a player disbands an Island
superiorskyblock.on_island_disband.descr: The `Island Disband Event` is triggered when an island is disbanded. This could be used to allow for some "re-birthing". So that the next time the players have bonuses or something.
superiorskyblock.on_island_invite.title: When a player is invited to a Skyblock island
superiorskyblock.on_island_invite.descri: The `Island Invite Event` is an event that is triggered when a player is invited to an island. This event could be used to give the player who got invited a reward.
superiorskyblock.on_island_join.title: When a player joins a Skyblock island
superiorskyblock.on_island_join.descript: The `Island Join Event` is fired when a player joins an island. This event could be used for a "better together" system, where players can join islands and get rewards for doing so.
superiorskyblock.on_island_upgrade.title: When a player upgrades their Skyblock island
superiorskyblock.on_island_upgrade.descr: The `Island Upgrade Event` is fired when a player upgrades their island. This event could be used to give players a reward when they upgrade their island.
superiorskyblock.on_mission_complete.tit: When a player completes a mission
superiorskyblock.on_mission_complete.des: The `Mission Complete` event is triggered when a player completes a mission. This event could be used to reward players for completing missions.
superiorskyblock.island_fact.title: Various facts about a player's island
superiorskyblock.island_fact.description: A [fact](/docs/creating-stories/facts) that can retrieve various information about an island. <fields.ReadonlyFactInfo /> Be aware that this fact will return -1 if the player is not in an island. This fact could be used to get the island's level and only allow some actions if the island is a certain level.
superiorskyblock.island_group.title: Group for the whole island
superiorskyblock.island_group.descriptio: The `Island Group` is a group that includes all the players on an island. This could be used to have facts that are specific to an island, like challenges for an island.
superiorskyblock.island_bank_deposit.tit: Deposit into a player's Island bank
superiorskyblock.island_bank_deposit.des: The `Island Bank Deposit Action` is used to deposit money into the player's Island bank. This could be used to reward players for completing a challenge or quest.
superiorskyblock.island_bank_withdraw.ti: Withdraw into a player's Island bank
superiorskyblock.island_bank_withdraw.de: The `Island Bank Withdraw` action allows you to withdraw money from the player's Island bank. This could be used to allow players to buy items from a shop.
